# Citizen North

> Citizen North is a hospitality production company creating photography and film for luxury hotels, resorts and tourism brands. Everything is produced in-house: creative direction, styling, casting, hair and makeup, architectural and lifestyle photography, video and post-production. We are an approved vendor for Fairmont Hotels & Resorts and Hilton, with crew in Vancouver, Los Angeles, Toronto, Montreal, London and Hong Kong.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://citizennorth.co/services/)
- [Luxury hotel and resort photography](https://citizennorth.co/services/hotel-photography/): Interiors, exteriors, suites and aerials.
- [Hotel lifestyle photography](https://citizennorth.co/services/hotel-lifestyle-photography/): Guests, dining, spa and experiences, cast and styled in-house.
- [Hotel and resort video production](https://citizennorth.co/services/hotel-video-production/): Brand films, social cuts and B-roll.
- [Full campaign production](https://citizennorth.co/services/hotel-campaign-production/): Creative direction, styling, casting, hair and makeup, crew and post.
- [Hotel restaurant and bar photography](https://citizennorth.co/services/hotel-restaurant-photography/): Dishes, cocktails, chefs and dining rooms.
- [Openings, renovations and rebrands](https://citizennorth.co/services/hotel-renovation-opening-photography/): New imagery ready when bookings open.
